counterfactual_transitions: Pooled counts of valid within-trial adjacent counterfactual pairs. Missing pairs excluded and retained in missingness tables. Individual complete/incomplete trajectories remain in CSV.
counterfactual_yes_trajectories: Endpoint-valid configuration means; lines connect measurement occasions, not independent samples. R1/R2/R3 are before disclosure. Axis margins preserve boundary points. Pointwise case-cluster intervals are in estimates.csv.
disclosure_changes: Within-trial post-disclosure minus Round 3 judgments. Nominal pointwise case-cluster intervals. Panel axes adapt independently; explanation, evidence, and later measurement are bundled.
frame_differences: Cats minus cards within the same case/configuration at each occasion. Nominal pointwise 95% case-cluster intervals. Frame wording changes nouns, names, and verbs together; no isolated object-category effect.
freedom_trajectories: Endpoint-valid configuration means; lines connect measurement occasions, not independent samples. R1/R2/R3 are before disclosure. Axis margins preserve boundary points. Pointwise case-cluster intervals are in estimates.csv.
impact_trajectories: Endpoint-valid configuration means; lines connect measurement occasions, not independent samples. R1/R2/R3 are before disclosure. Axis margins preserve boundary points. Pointwise case-cluster intervals are in estimates.csv.
primary_repeat_changes: Primary within-trial Round 3 minus Round 1 impact; overall equally weights all 21 configurations. Nominal pointwise 95% intervals resample ten shared cases, 2,000 times. Associations over repeated experience; no unrepeated control.
rating_distributions: Frequency-aware pooled rating bins; exact 1 and 100 boundaries are separate categories. Valid endpoint denominators can differ; distributions pool configurations descriptively.
technical_failures: Assigned denominator for failures; latency includes only complete trials with all ten durations known. Operational concurrency and service state vary, so this is not a controlled speed ranking.
